product_pages.semantic_note: Feature nouns are value categories; Runtime remains a technical term and should not absorb Agent, Model or Tools.
Evaluation method and evidence links are separate from current product capability.
Expert, Binding and Execution are distinct backstage or domain terms; do not collapse them into one agent object.
The preview dialog is an installation explanation; no desktop build is claimed.
The CLI is a read/replay surface; command buttons are disabled until its script is active.
Journal entries link pinned commits; they describe changes and do not establish current acceptance.
Model, provider, endpoint and runtime are separate facts; the capture says no address/key was entered and no provider was probed.
Tool, Plugin, Connection and MCP are named as separate boundaries; do not use one integration glyph or word for all four.
